tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background (the envelope). Ground for ink (16.1:1), muted (4.6:1) and rose text 24px+ (3.7:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on cream: inputs, letters, cards. Ground for ink (17.3:1) and muted (4.9:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on cream, paper and blush; primary buttons; the footer. Cream and blush text sit on it at 16.1:1 and 13.2:1.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Hover state of ink buttons.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cream (4.6:1) and paper (4.9:1) only. Not on blush, line or rose.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, borders and dividers on cream and paper. Never text (1.2:1).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Brand accent: highlighted words 24px+ on cream (3.7:1) and paper (4.0:1), the logo's full stop, hearts, filled marks. Not for text under 24px; use rose-deep.

tokens.name: rose-deep
tokens.usage: Small rose text on cream (5.1:1): step numbers, links. Hover for rose fills, and the recommended fill behind small cream text (5.5:1).

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft tint and selection. Highlight text on ink (13.2:1) and wine (9.4:1). Ink text on it reads 13.2:1.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: Deep romantic surface (anniversary, love). Cream text on it reads 11.4:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Candle flames, sparkles and confetti. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: occasion-frosting
tokens.usage: Gift ground for Make a Wish (₹149). Text ink-wine #43111f, accent #e8344e.

tokens.name: occasion-butter
tokens.usage: Gift ground for Candle (₹99). Text #3b2410, accent #e2683b.

tokens.name: occasion-midnight
tokens.usage: Gift ground for The Party (₹179). Text #fdeefe, accent #ff5c8a.

tokens.name: occasion-mint
tokens.usage: Editor theme Mint. Text #12352a, accent #ff6b5b.

tokens.name: occasion-lavender
tokens.usage: Editor theme Lavender. Text #2b1a4a, accent #7c4dff.

tokens.name: occasion-ocean
tokens.usage: Editor theme Ocean. Text #eaf6ff, accent #4cc9f0.

tokens.name: occasion-noir
tokens.usage: Editor theme Noir & gold. Text #f5f0e8, accent #e8c26b.

styles.name: copy
